dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>So this goes over there... No, wait, maybe here...
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$kfacial(1)><$motion(1,807)>Hmmmmmm...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Então, isto vai para ali...
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$kfacial(1)><$motion(1,807)>Hmmmmmm...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>Oh, hello, <$cdef(27)>! Sorry I didn’t
notice
you there!
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,664)><$facial(1,1)>I was so caught up in what I was doing—getting ready
to move!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>Olá. <$cdef(27)>! Desculpe, eu não fiz
aviso
Tu aí!
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,664)><$facial(1,1)>Estava tão envolvido no que estava a fazer, a preparar-me
Para se mexer!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)>When I saw that building we found on the beach take off
into the sky...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)>Quando vi o edifício que encontrámos na praia decolar.
para o céu...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,14)>It made me think—or perhaps it’s just a gut feeling...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,14)>Fez-me pensar – ou talvez seja apenas um pressentimento...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)><$facial(1,4)>What if the humans did that too, and moved to a new
home up in the sky? It’s possible!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)><$facial(1,4)>E se os humanos fizessem isso também, e se mudassem para um novo
casa no céu? É possível!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)>Looking back, I’ve lived in this cave for an awfully long
time. I thought maybe it was time <$voicel(1,4)>for me to make a new
home and move.<$motion(1,651)>
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)>Olhando para trás, eu vivi nesta caverna por muito tempo
Pensei que talvez estivesse na hora. <$voicel(1,4)>para que eu faça um novo
para casa e para casa.<$motion(1,651)>

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>But when I tried to think of what I should put where, my
thoughts kept going round and round until my head
was spinning!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Mas quando eu tentei pensar no que eu deveria colocar onde, meu
pensamentos continuou a girar e girar até a minha cabeça
Estava a girar!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>But now I’ve had a fine idea! Would YOU make my new
home, <$cdef(27)>?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Mas agora eu tive uma boa idéia! VOCÊ faria meu novo
casa, <$cdef(27)>?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,659)><$facial(1,5)>You’ve helped so many Pokémon with their requests up
until now, I daresay you’re a homebuilding pro!
<$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)>I’m sure you could make me a wonderful home!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,659)><$facial(1,5)>Você ajudou tantos Pokémon com seus pedidos para cima
até agora, eu ouso dizer que você é um profissional de construção de casa!
<$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)>Tenho certeza de que você poderia me tornar uma casa maravilhosa!

dialogues.en:
<$facial(1,5)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,668)>Oho! So you’ll do it? That will be a tremendous help! But it
wouldn’t do to leave EVERYTHING to you, <$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,14)>so I’ll try to
think of what I’d like to have in my home...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$facial(1,5)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,668)>Oho! Então você vai fazer isso? Isso será uma ajuda tremenda! Mas
não faria para deixar tudo para você, <$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,14)>assim que eu vou tentar
pensar no que eu gostaria de ter em minha casa...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,40)>Hmmm... Oh, of course! You know that wheelbarrow in
my cave?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,40)>Claro que conheces o carrinho de mão.
A minha caverna?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,38)>No home of mine would be complete without that! I most
certainly want it in my new home too.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,38)>Nenhum lar meu estaria completo sem isso!
Certamente também o quero na minha nova casa.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,9)><$kfacial(1)>Now let’s see, what else would be nice? Hmmm...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,9)><$kfacial(1)>Agora vamos ver, o que mais seria bom? Hmmm...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)><$facial(1,4)>In that case, I’d like to have some human tools around!
They’re always exciting to look at!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)><$facial(1,4)>Nesse caso, eu gostaria de ter algumas ferramentas humanas ao redor!
Eles são sempre emocionantes de olhar!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,49)>And how about one of those <$cdef(27)><$ifull(3997)> you
sometimes show me?
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,1)>Put ’em all together and you get something like...this!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,49)>E que tal um desses <$cdef(27)><$ifull(3997)> você
Às vezes, mostra-me?
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,1)>Juntem-nos todos e você terá algo como... isto!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>I’m not too picky about the exact placement. I’ll leave the
arrangement to you and your sense of style!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Eu não sou muito exigente sobre a colocação exata.
arranjo para você e seu senso de estilo!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, right. One last thing. You can put my new home
anywhere you want—as long as it’s not too far away.
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)>I’m not getting any younger, after all.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Uma última coisa, pode pôr o meu novo lar.
em qualquer lugar que você quiser – contanto que não seja muito longe.
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)>Afinal de contas, não estou ficando mais jovem.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$comeff(1,9)>I look forward to seeing what you create,
<$cdef(27)>!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$comeff(1,9)>Estou ansioso para ver o que você cria,
<$cdef(27)>!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Please do this old Pokémon a favor and make me a new
home to move into! <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,1)>But not too far away.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Por favor, faça um favor a este velho Pokémon e faça-me um novo
Para casa, para morar! <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,1)>Mas não muito longe.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>! I hear you’ve finished
making my new home!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, Oh, <$cdef(27)>Ouvi dizer que você terminou
A fazer a minha nova casa!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>That makes me so happy! I look forward to living there!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>Isso me faz tão feliz! Estou ansioso para viver lá!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>I must say, this is a very fine home you’ve made for me!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Devo dizer, este é um lar muito bom que você fez para mim!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,5)>The human tools are an excellent accent. I knew I could
trust your taste, <$cdef(27)>. It’s so...
<$voicel(1,2)><$facial(1,9)>s-so...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,5)>As ferramentas humanas são um excelente sotaque.
Confie no seu gosto, <$cdef(27)>É tão...
<$voicel(1,2)><$facial(1,9)>Então...

dialogues.en: <$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)>Ah-CHOO!
dialogues.pt_br: <$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)>Ah-choo!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,23)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)><$kfacial(1)>Brrr... It’s...just a little chilly, I’m afraid. I think I might catch
a cold here...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,23)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)><$kfacial(1)>Brrr... É... apenas um pouco frio, eu tenho medo. Eu acho que eu posso pegar
Um resfriado aqui...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>I apologize for asking so much of you, but do you think
you could place a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)> nearby?
<$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)>And don’t forget to set it alight!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Peço desculpa por pedir tanto de ti, mas achas
você poderia colocar um <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)> Perto?
<$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)>E não se esqueça de atear fogo!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Place a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1280)></color> near my home and light it, please!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Colocar a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1280)></color> Perto da minha casa e acende-a, por favor!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,27)>Oho! I see you’ve placed that <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1280)></color>!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,27)>Oho! Vejo que você colocou que <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1280)></color>!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>Are you asking about my comfort level? I can assure you,
it couldn’t be better! <$voicel(1,6)>Now I can stay nice and warm.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>está a perguntar sobre o meu nível de conforto?
não poderia ser melhor! <$voicel(1,6)>Agora posso ficar bem e quente.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>You know, this reminds me... Way back when we first met,
you prepared a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)> for me, just like this.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>sabe, isto lembra-me...
você preparou uma <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)> Para mim, assim.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,3)><$facial(1,14)>You and I have sure come a long way together.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,3)><$facial(1,14)>Tu e eu percorremos um longo caminho juntos.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)>Back when I was traveling on my own, searching for some
trace of what happened to the humans, <$voicel(1,6)>I never could
have imagined this...<$motion(1,654)>
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)>Quando eu estava viajando por conta própria, à procura de alguns
vestígios do que aconteceu aos humanos, <$voicel(1,6)>Eu nunca consegui
Imaginei isto...<$motion(1,654)>

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,5)><$motion(1,668)>That the world could be restored so beautifully...or that
I’d make such a steadfast friend!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,5)><$motion(1,668)>Que o mundo poderia ser restaurado tão lindamente... ou que
Eu faria um amigo tão firme!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$kfacial(1)><$facial(1,4)>I’m truly grateful! For all the time you’ve spent with me...
<$voicel(1,8)>Thank you so much!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$kfacial(1)><$facial(1,4)>Eu sou verdadeiramente grato! Por todo o tempo que você passou comigo...
<$voicel(1,8)>Muito obrigado!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,659)>Every day since meeting you has been a happy one!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,659)>Todos os dias desde que te conheci tem sido feliz!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Right then! Now that you’ve built me such a splendid
home, <$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,4)>I feel more motivated than ever!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Certo então! Agora que você me construiu um tão esplêndido
casa, <$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,4)>Sinto-me mais motivado do que nunca!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,664)>I’ll put my all into this, as much now as I ever have!
Until the humans return, <$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)>I’ll keep trying to make this
place even more beautiful!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,664)>Vou me esforçar por tudo isso, tanto quanto já fiz!
Até que os humanos regressem, <$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)>Vou continuar tentando fazer isso
lugar ainda mais bonito!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)>And I hope you’ll be by my side,
<$cdef(27)>!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)>E espero que estejas ao meu lado,
<$cdef(27)>!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,50)>If you ever need help, I’ll always be here.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,50)>Se você precisar de ajuda, eu sempre estarei aqui.
